ECON_CLASSICAL.name: Classical Economics
ECON_CLASSICAL.description: Focuses on individual rational choices and market equilibrium. This approach values personal responsibility and the organic efficiency of balanced systems.

ECON_KEYNESIAN.name: Keynesian Economics
ECON_KEYNESIAN.description: Emphasizes aggregate demand and proactive intervention. This perspective values collective stability and the wisdom of timely, supportive action.

ECON_MONETARIST.name: Monetarism
ECON_MONETARIST.description: Focuses on money supply and long-term price stability. Values consistency, clear rules, and the predictability of fundamental systems.

ECON_BEHAVIORAL.name: Behavioral Economics
ECON_BEHAVIORAL.description: Applies psychological insights to explain economic decisions. Values human understanding, empathy, and the nuanced reality of everyday choices.

ECON_AUSTRIAN.name: Austrian School
ECON_AUSTRIAN.description: Emphasizes entrepreneurial discovery and subjectivism. Values creative liberty, personal insight, and the unique value of individual perspectives.

POL_CONSERVATISM.name: Conservatism
POL_CONSERVATISM.description: Values tradition, stability, and gradual reform. This approach seeks to preserve hard-won wisdom while ensuring a secure and steady future.

POL_LIBERALISM.name: Liberalism
POL_LIBERALISM.description: Emphasizes individual liberty, equality, and progress. Values the freedom to explore new possibilities and the inherent dignity of every person.

POL_SOCIALISM.name: Socialism
POL_SOCIALISM.description: Focuses on social justice, equality, and community welfare. Values mutual support, collective well-being, and the strength found in solidarity.

POL_LIBERTARIANISM.name: Libertarianism
POL_LIBERTARIANISM.description: Prioritizes minimal intervention and maximum individual autonomy. Values self-determination and the protection of private space and initiative.

POL_MODERATISM.name: Moderatism
POL_MODERATISM.description: Seeks a balance between order and progress. Values pragmatic solutions, dialogue, and the finding of common ground for the greater good.
